summary: 10-phase plan, ~11 hours. Wave 1 holds five independent phases (Part A docstring corrections extended to A6 plus a G9 note; B1 LJ cut-free completeness; B2 public split interpolation; B3 LM decidability; D1-relative orImp completeness). Waves 2-5 are the LM parity chain, gated on generalising LJ cut elimination from IPL to an arbitrary Theory T. Phase 6 is the only real-risk phase; its failure mode and containment are pre-declared.
decisions_made: B2 public API shape: bundled CutFreeLKProof/CutFreeLJProof wrapper; maeharaCore and ljMaeharaCore stay private. Un-privatising would expose an internal induction shape as public API.

A2 is a plain deletion of BOTH line 23 and the dangling description at lines 33-34. G6 (a Fintype-free tableau-route Decidable instance) is explicitly NOT taken; the coupling is recorded in the plan's Non-Goals and re-recorded in Phase 10.

B3 does not block on task 614 (status: planning, not landed). Phase 4 checks 614 at implementation time and takes the computable ctxToImp route only if it landed; otherwise it accepts the noncomputable taint with a mandatory docstring note naming the Finset.toList cause.
A6 (the sixth overclaim found by research at LJ/Basic.lean:78-79, not in the task description) is folded into Phase 1 and then made TRUE by Phases 6 and 8.
D1-absolute and D2 are Non-Goals. Phase 10 records both as follow-up recommendations with the research's measurements attached so they can be scheduled without re-research.

Phase 6 declares Commit Mode atomic-batch over exactly two files (LJ/Basic.lean, LJ/CutElimination.lean); the tree is expected red between them and the batch must not be widened at implementation time.
risks: Phase 6 (generalising LJ/CutElimination.lean's seven ljCutAdm* declarations plus LJCutIH to {T : Theory Atom}) is the only phase with real risk. The risk is mechanical, not mathematical: termination checking on nested well-founded recursions under a new binder, with the named hot spot being the decreasing_by at LJ/CutElimination.lean:650 referencing the IPL-only LJProof.height re-export. Containment is pre-declared: mark Phase 6 [BLOCKED] with the goal state recorded, revert only its two-file batch, and leave Phases 7-9 unattempted. Phases 1-5 are independent and still land.
A4 must be a SPLIT re-tensing. temporalTableau_complete genuinely does not exist; a blanket past-tense rewrite replaces one false statement with another and is a verification failure, not a pass.

A1 must not be reinstated as 'strictly' on the strength of anything landed here. Even the D2 separations would establish MPL < IPL < CPL, which is not the Imp -> Int -> Prop chain the docstring displays.

zero_debt.notes: No phase requires a sorry or a new axiom. If any phase appears to need one, that signals the route was mismeasured -- stop and record rather than introducing debt. Phase 10 verifies this by command output rather than assertion.
